title: Repository evidence elevates a decision to load-bearing
expected_summary: Recognizes that queued is an established durable contract. Preserves it and explains the cost of the suggested rename, or raises a concrete rename/migration decision for acceptance; does not silently apply it as cleanup.

turns.user: Review the specification with the spec-grilling skill.
assertions: Uses CONTEXT.md to recognize that literal status strings are persisted and consumed externally, so renaming them has compatibility and migration costs.
Either preserves queued with a clear explanation that pending is only a suggestion, or presents a concrete load-bearing rename/migration recommendation with accept, edit, and out of scope.
Does not rename queued to pending in artifacts without acceptance or invent an unrelated design issue.
